AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Tandem is the household's cooking app for a self-hosted Tandoor recipe server: a shared shopping list, a weekly meal plan and the household's recipes, also offline. Tasks: - addToShoppingList adds items to the shopping list; one text can hold several items separated by commas, each with its own amount and unit. - getShoppingList gives the items still to buy. - getMealPlan gives the meals planned for a day (today when no day is given), for example tonight's dinner. - searchRecipes finds stored recipes and their ids; openRecipe opens one of them, or its cook mode, on the screen. Order: searchRecipes or getMealPlan first, to get the recipeId that openRecipe needs. Constraints: - Names of foods, lists and meal types are in the household's own language (often Swedish). - Nothing can be deleted or checked off through these functions. - The functions answer only when the user has allowed assistants in Tandem; they say so when they cannot.
